_comment: Passed to every board-driven `claude -p` run as --settings. The hook is the write boundary described in tools/board/guard_write.py; the per-run allowlist reaches it through $JOBFLOW_ALLOWLIST. tools/board/runs.py re-validates this file's exact shape before every spawn, because a malformed --settings file is accepted silently by the CLI and the run then has no guard at all. Tracked in git on purpose: it holds no identity, and CI should see it.
